messages:
sara: quick sync — FinBank wants airgapped POC. Main asks: 1) signed image transport + verification workflow, 2) cert rotation timing during offline upgrades, 3) license activation grace for delayed network, 4) operator upgrade cadence they can approve. anyone handled bank-level regulators?

mike: we did a similar run with HealthCo Q4. short checklist:
- produce signed tarball + sbom
- ship via SFTP or physical media
- installer CLI with signature verification
- immutable image tags for operator upgrades

snippet:
```bash
redwood-cli sign --artifact bundle.tar.gz --key=redwood-prod.pem
``` 
cert rotation note: needs a maintenance window; we recommend staggered node restarts and KV cache warmup to avoid latency spikes.

priya: on the pricing/licensing side — they asked about perpetual vs reserved. can we offer a 30d activation window for POC if they can't reach our license server immediately? also what's the delta for offline support during POC?

mike: yes, 30d grace for POC. production offline requires signed license file + attestation. offline-support add-on is a fixed SOW line item.

danielle: flagging legal items — export controls + bank regs. we need the customer's SOC2/ISO docs and a minimal ATO packet. also confirm HSM key custody model for signing.

kevin: for HSM/offline we support importing customer HSM public keys and an offline signing workflow. ops runbook has the step-by-step and includes integrity checks + SBOM verification.

ops-bot: ops doc posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/airgap/offline-signing (internal) — includes installer checksum steps and USB transfer checklist :link:

sara: ok — can we convert this into a short POC runbook (deliverable + acceptance criteria + expected windows) to send to AE + FinBank? i'll draft and circulate for review.

mike: will upload the signed-image workflow + sample runbook by EOD. :thumbsup:
